message.zh: 来自本地 API 的明确标记演示种子；待审核内容已从公共快照隔离。
message.en: Explicitly labelled demo seed served by the local API; pending review data is isolated.

summary.zh: Anthropic 提供的终端编码 Agent，可阅读代码、编辑文件、运行测试并在用户监督下使用命令行工具。
summary.en: Anthropic's terminal coding agent that can read code, edit files, run tests and use command-line tools with user oversight.

introduction.zh: Claude Code 是 Anthropic 发布的命令行编码 Agent。
introduction.en: Claude Code is Anthropic's command-line coding agent.

introduction.zh: 它能在项目中搜索、编辑和运行测试，但仍应保持用户对变更和权限的控制。
introduction.en: It can search, edit and test projects, while users should retain control over changes and permissions.

significance.zh: Claude Code 代表模型能力通过终端和开发工作流进入工程现场。
significance.en: Claude Code brings model capability into engineering workflows through the terminal.

description.zh: 官方说明其可搜索和读取代码、编辑文件、编写并运行测试。
description.en: Anthropic states it can search and read code, edit files, write and run tests.

description.zh: 命令和代码变更应在用户的权限边界下执行。
description.en: Commands and code changes should execute within user-controlled permission boundaries.

description.zh: 适合在终端中委派较大的工程任务。
description.en: It is designed for delegating substantial engineering work from the terminal.

description.zh: 搜索文件和调用关系，辅助开发者理解陌生项目。
description.en: Search files and call paths to help developers understand unfamiliar projects.

description.zh: 修改后运行已有测试，缩小缺陷修复风险。
description.en: Run existing tests after edits to reduce fix risk.

description.zh: 提出重构方案并由工程师审查范围和结果。
description.en: Draft refactors for engineers to review for scope and correctness.

limitations.zh: 对大型或模糊任务应拆分并持续审查。
limitations.en: Large or ambiguous tasks should be decomposed and continually reviewed.

limitations.zh: 不能将其输出视为自动正确的生产代码。
limitations.en: Its output is not automatically production-correct code.

summary.zh: 面向软件工程任务的云端编码 Agent，可在隔离环境中处理功能开发、排错和代码审查任务。
summary.en: Cloud-based coding agent for software engineering tasks in isolated work environments.

capabilities.zh: 并行处理软件工程任务
代码库任务执行与测试

introduction.zh: Codex 是 OpenAI 面向软件工程任务的 Agent 产品，用户可以把功能开发、修复和代码审查任务委派给它。
introduction.en: Codex is OpenAI's agent product for software engineering tasks such as features, fixes and code review.

introduction.zh: 它的价值应通过实际任务范围、权限、测试结果和人工审查来判断，而不是把模型名称当作交付保证。
introduction.en: Its value should be judged through task scope, permissions, test results and human review rather than model branding.

significance.zh: Codex 把编码模型能力包装为可执行、可审查的软件工程工作流。
significance.en: Codex packages coding-model capability into an executable, reviewable engineering workflow.

description.zh: 官方介绍将每项任务放在预加载代码库的云端沙箱中执行。
description.en: The official introduction describes tasks running in cloud sandboxes preloaded with a repository.

description.zh: 可同时处理多个相互独立的软件工程任务。
description.en: It can work on multiple independent engineering tasks in parallel.

description.zh: 输出应以变更和测试结果接受人工审查。
description.en: Outputs should be reviewed as changes with test results.

description.zh: 将边界清晰的功能任务交给 Agent 完成初稿与验证。
description.en: Delegate well-scoped features for a draft and validation.

description.zh: 用于定位、修改并运行测试验证修复。
description.en: Use it to investigate, change and test fixes.

description.zh: 辅助发现变更风险，但不能替代最终负责的评审者。
description.en: Assist with change-risk discovery without replacing accountable reviewers.

limitations.zh: 能力受仓库、权限、任务拆分和测试覆盖率影响。
limitations.en: Results depend on the repository, permissions, task decomposition and test coverage.

limitations.zh: 高风险变更仍必须由人类审查和批准。
limitations.en: High-risk changes still require human review and approval.

summary.zh: Cognition 提供的 AI 软件工程产品，官方文档描述其可编写、运行和测试代码，并提供 IDE、终端和浏览器工作区。
summary.en: Cognition's AI software engineering product that can write, run and test code with an IDE, shell and browser workspace.

introduction.zh: Devin 是 AI 软件工程产品，面向代码实现、测试、排错和工程任务管理。
introduction.en: Devin is an AI software engineering product for implementation, testing, debugging and engineering task management.

introduction.zh: 官方文档强调对小范围、边界明确的任务效果更好；复杂任务仍需要拆分、评审和验证。
introduction.en: Its documentation emphasizes better outcomes on clear, scoped tasks; complex work still needs decomposition, review and verification.

significance.zh: Devin 将 Agent、IDE、终端和浏览器组合为可观察的软件工程工作区。
significance.en: Devin combines an agent, IDE, shell and browser into an observable engineering workspace.

description.zh: 官方文档称其能够编写、运行和测试代码。
description.en: Official documentation states it can write, run and test code.

description.zh: 用户可以在嵌入式 IDE、终端和浏览器中查看或接管工作。
description.en: Users can observe or take over work in an embedded IDE, shell and browser.

description.zh: 文档建议将复杂工作拆为隔离的小任务。
description.en: The documentation recommends splitting complex work into isolated smaller tasks.

description.zh: 处理范围清晰的前端、缺陷和测试覆盖任务。
description.en: Handle scoped frontend, bug and test-coverage work.

description.zh: 先拆解迁移，再通过测试和代码评审验证。
description.en: Decompose migrations first, then validate through tests and review.

description.zh: 复现并定位失败，但发布前仍需维护者批准。
description.en: Reproduce and diagnose failures while retaining maintainer approval before release.

limitations.zh: 复杂或模糊问题不应直接交给单个长任务。
limitations.en: Complex or ambiguous problems should not be handed to one long task unchanged.

limitations.zh: 自动生成的代码需要安全、测试和架构审查。
limitations.en: Generated code requires security, testing and architecture review.

summary.zh: Google 发布的开源终端 AI Agent，将 Gemini 能力带入编码、问题解决和任务管理工作流。
summary.en: Google's open-source terminal AI agent bringing Gemini to coding, problem-solving and task management workflows.

introduction.zh: Gemini CLI 是 Google 发布的开源终端 Agent。
introduction.en: Gemini CLI is Google's open-source terminal agent.

introduction.zh: 它面向开发、问题解决与任务管理，使用前需要根据个人账户或 API/云平台配置核对访问范围。
introduction.en: It targets development, problem solving and task management; access depends on account or API/cloud configuration.

significance.zh: Gemini CLI 提供了将 Gemini 模型能力接入本地开发终端的官方入口。
significance.en: Gemini CLI is Google's official entry point for bringing Gemini into local developer terminals.

description.zh: Google 将其定义为把 Gemini 直接带入终端的开源 AI Agent。
description.en: Google describes it as an open-source AI agent bringing Gemini directly into the terminal.

description.zh: 官方说明覆盖编码、问题解决和任务管理。
description.en: The official announcement covers coding, problem solving and task management.

description.zh: 个人账号、AI Studio 和 Vertex AI 的访问配置不同。
description.en: Personal account, AI Studio and Vertex AI access configurations differ.

description.zh: 在命令行中处理代码解释、生成和修改建议。
description.en: Handle code explanation, generation and change proposals in the command line.

description.zh: 将自然语言问题转换为可执行的开发步骤。
description.en: Turn natural-language questions into executable development steps.

description.zh: 结合项目测试和人工审查验证小范围原型。
description.en: Combine project tests and human review for scoped prototypes.

limitations.zh: 开源客户端不代表所有模型、配额或云权限都免费。
limitations.en: An open-source client does not make every model, quota or cloud permission free.

limitations.zh: 本地命令和文件访问仍需要明确的权限边界。
limitations.en: Local commands and file access still need explicit permission boundaries.

summary.zh: 自主通用 AI Agent，官方文档将其描述为能在沙箱环境中规划、执行并交付任务成果的产品。
summary.en: Autonomous general AI agent described by its documentation as planning, executing and delivering task outcomes in a sandbox environment.

introduction.zh: Manus 是面向端到端任务交付的通用 Agent 产品。
introduction.en: Manus is a general agent product for end-to-end task delivery.

introduction.zh: 它的文档强调沙箱环境、文件系统和工具安装能力；实际可用能力仍取决于任务、权限和账户配置。
introduction.en: Its documentation emphasizes sandboxes, filesystems and tool installation; practical capability still depends on task, permissions and account configuration.

significance.zh: Manus 将通用 Agent 的价值定位在完成任务产物，而不是仅给出对话回复。
significance.en: Manus positions general-agent value around delivered work products rather than chat responses alone.

description.zh: 官方文档将其描述为可以规划、执行并交付完整工作成果的 Agent。
description.en: The official documentation describes an agent that can plan, execute and deliver complete work products.

description.zh: 文档提到独立虚拟计算机、网络和持久文件系统。
description.en: The documentation describes a virtual computer, network access and persistent filesystem.

description.zh: 应根据工具授权和任务范围评估它能否实际完成目标。
description.en: Assess completion against tool authorization and task scope.

description.zh: 在授权来源范围内收集并整理任务材料。
description.en: Collect and organize task material within authorized sources.

description.zh: 把多步骤流程组织为可检查的任务。
description.en: Organize multi-step processes into inspectable tasks.

description.zh: 生成文档、表格或其他工作产物，并保留核验步骤。
description.en: Create documents, tables or other work products while retaining verification steps.

limitations.zh: 自主执行不等于可绕过权限、隐私和人工审查。
limitations.en: Autonomy does not bypass permissions, privacy or human review.

limitations.zh: 外部网络和工具结果应单独核验。
limitations.en: External network and tool results should be verified independently.

summary.zh: 面向软件开发的 AI 代码编辑器，把代码库检索、问答、补全、多文件编辑、终端命令与自主 Agent 集成在同一工作环境中。
summary.en: AI code editor combining codebase search, Q&A, completion, multi-file editing, terminal commands and autonomous agents.

introduction.zh: Cursor 是面向软件开发的 AI 代码编辑器。它把传统编辑器能力与模型对话、代码库检索、补全、内联修改和 Agent 模式结合，使 AI 可以在理解项目上下文后跨文件修改代码、运行命令并根据结果继续迭代。
introduction.en: Cursor is an AI code editor combining traditional editing with model chat, codebase retrieval, completion, inline edits and agents that can modify files, run commands and iterate on results.

introduction.zh: Cursor 的 Agent 适合完成复杂功能和重构；Ask 模式偏向只读理解；精确编辑模式适合控制修改范围。它本身不是一个基础模型，而是把不同模型、上下文检索和开发工具组织成完整工作流的应用层产品。
introduction.en: Agent handles complex features and refactors, while Ask favors read-only understanding and targeted modes limit edits. Cursor is an application layer combining models, retrieval and developer tools, not a foundation model.

significance.zh: Cursor 代表 AI 编程从“给出代码建议”走向“理解仓库并执行多步骤任务”。评价它不能只看底层模型，还要看检索、编辑、终端工具、差异审查和用户控制是否形成可靠闭环。
significance.en: Cursor represents the shift from code suggestions to repository-aware multi-step execution. Its value depends on retrieval, editing, terminal tools, diff review and user control—not only the underlying model.

description.zh: 可自主搜索代码库、编辑多个文件、运行终端命令并完成复杂任务。
description.en: Autonomously searches a codebase, edits files, runs terminal commands and completes complex tasks.

description.zh: 只读搜索和解释代码，适合理解项目后再决定是否修改。
description.en: Read-only search and explanation for understanding a project before editing.

description.zh: 以增删行差异检查 AI 修改，允许开发者在接受前保持控制。
description.en: Review additions and deletions before accepting AI-generated changes.

description.zh: 通过语义搜索和问答定位架构、调用链与关键文件。
description.en: Use semantic search and Q&A to locate architecture, call paths and key files.

description.zh: 让 Agent 修改实现、测试和配置，并运行检查验证结果。
description.en: Let an agent update implementation, tests and config, then run checks.

description.zh: 结合代码检索、终端和差异审查完成可控迭代。
description.en: Combine retrieval, terminal tools and diff review for controlled iteration.

limitations.zh: Agent 可能产生范围过大的修改或错误假设，关键变更仍需要人工审查和测试。
limitations.en: Agents can make overly broad changes or incorrect assumptions; critical work still needs review and testing.

limitations.zh: 实际体验受所选模型、代码库规模、索引质量、上下文和工具权限影响。
limitations.en: Results depend on model choice, repository size, indexing quality, context and tool permissions.

summary.zh: 面向专业知识与多步推理的高难度多学科选择题评测；通过更难题目和十选一设置增强区分度与提示稳定性。
summary.en: Challenging multi-domain benchmark for expert knowledge and reasoning, using harder questions and ten choices for stronger discrimination and prompt stability.

introduction.zh: MMLU-Pro 是在经典 MMLU 基础上设计的更困难、更稳健的多任务语言理解评测。它增加需要推理的专业级问题，把每题选项从四个扩展为十个，并清理部分简单或噪声较高的问题。
introduction.en: MMLU-Pro is a harder, more robust successor to MMLU. It adds reasoning-heavy professional questions, expands choices from four to ten and removes some trivial or noisy items.

introduction.zh: 它主要测试模型跨学科知识和推理的综合表现，适合观察模型在数学、物理、法律、健康等领域的广度，但不能单独代表对话体验、事实可靠性、代码能力或真实业务效果。
introduction.en: It tests broad knowledge and reasoning across fields such as mathematics, physics, law and health, but does not by itself represent chat quality, factual reliability, coding or business outcomes.

significance.zh: 当传统 MMLU 对前沿模型的区分度下降时，MMLU-Pro 用更难问题和更多选项重新拉开差距，并降低不同提示措辞造成的分数波动。
significance.en: As frontier models saturated MMLU, MMLU-Pro restored separation with harder questions and more choices while reducing prompt sensitivity.

description.zh: 论文报告相较 MMLU，模型准确率普遍下降 16%–33%。
description.en: The paper reports accuracy drops of 16–33% compared with MMLU.

description.zh: 每题从四选一扩展到十选一，降低随机猜中的概率。
description.en: Questions expand from four to ten choices, reducing random-guess success.

description.zh: 论文测试 24 种提示风格，分数波动低于原始 MMLU。
description.en: Across 24 prompt styles, scores varied less than on original MMLU.

description.zh: 快速观察模型跨领域知识与推理是否存在明显短板。
description.en: Screen for broad knowledge and reasoning weaknesses.

description.zh: 在相同提示和评测实现下比较同系列版本。
description.en: Compare versions under the same prompt and evaluation implementation.

description.zh: 和代码、数学、安全、事实性等专项评测结合形成完整画像。
description.en: Combine with coding, math, safety and factuality evaluations.

limitations.zh: 选择题成绩可能受提示模板、答案解析方式和数据污染影响。
limitations.en: Multiple-choice scores can be affected by prompts, answer parsing and contamination.

limitations.zh: 高分不等于在开放式任务、真实工作流或特定语言环境中表现同样优秀。
limitations.en: A high score does not guarantee open-ended, workflow or multilingual performance.

summary.zh: 以真实开源仓库 GitHub Issue 为任务、通过运行测试验证补丁的代码 Agent 评测；Verified 子集包含 500 个经工程师确认可解决的实例。
summary.en: Coding-agent benchmark built from real GitHub issues and test-validated patches; its Verified subset contains 500 engineer-confirmed solvable instances.

introduction.zh: SWE-bench 用真实 GitHub 仓库中的 Issue 和对应修复来评估模型的软件工程能力。模型不仅要写一段看起来合理的代码，还要理解仓库、定位问题、生成可应用的补丁，并通过该项目的测试套件。
introduction.en: SWE-bench evaluates software-engineering ability using real GitHub issues and their fixes. A model must understand a repository, locate the problem, produce an applicable patch and pass the project's tests.

introduction.zh: SWE-bench Verified 是其中更常用于模型对比的子集，包含 500 个由软件工程师确认可解决的问题。它比单函数代码题更接近真实开发，但最终分数也会受到 Agent 脚手架、工具、上下文策略和尝试次数影响。
introduction.en: SWE-bench Verified contains 500 tasks confirmed solvable by software engineers. It is more realistic than isolated coding questions, but scores also depend on agent scaffolding, tools, context strategy and attempts.

significance.zh: 它把“会生成代码”推进到“能否完成真实仓库修复”，因此常被用来判断代码模型和代码 Agent 的端到端工程能力。
significance.en: It shifts evaluation from generating code snippets to completing real repository fixes, making it useful for end-to-end coding-agent assessment.

description.zh: 真实开源仓库中的 GitHub Issue 及其对应修复。
description.en: Real GitHub issues and corresponding fixes from open-source repositories.

description.zh: 在隔离环境中应用模型补丁并运行仓库测试，通过测试才算解决。
description.en: Apply the generated patch in an isolated environment and run repository tests.

description.zh: 500 个由工程师确认可解决的实例。
description.en: 500 instances verified by engineers as solvable.

description.zh: 比较不同模型与 Agent 系统在真实缺陷修复上的成功率。
description.en: Compare models and agents on real defect-resolution success.

description.zh: 评估搜索、编辑、测试和上下文管理策略是否真正提升完成率。
description.en: Evaluate whether search, editing, testing and context strategies improve completion.

description.zh: 在相近评测设置下观察同一模型系列的版本迭代。
description.en: Track version changes under comparable evaluation settings.

limitations.zh: 分数并非纯模型能力：Agent 脚手架、工具权限、采样次数和测试环境都会影响结果。
limitations.en: Scores are not pure model ability; scaffolding, permissions, attempts and environment matter.

limitations.zh: 排行榜结果只有在评测版本和运行设置一致时才适合横向比较。
limitations.en: Leaderboard results are comparable only when benchmark versions and run settings align.

summary.zh: 以可靠、可解释和可控 AI 系统为研究重点的人工智能安全与研究公司，也是 Claude 系列的开发者。
summary.en: AI safety and research company focused on reliable, interpretable and steerable systems, and the developer of Claude.

capabilities.zh: 前沿模型与 Claude 产品
AI 安全与可解释性研究

introduction.zh: Anthropic 是一家人工智能安全与研究公司，目标是构建可靠、可解释且可控的 AI 系统。它把安全研究落实到 Claude 模型、API 和企业产品中，并持续发布有关对齐、可解释性、治理和社会影响的研究。
introduction.en: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company building reliable, interpretable and steerable systems. It applies that research through Claude, APIs and enterprise products while publishing work on alignment, interpretability, governance and societal impact.

introduction.zh: 在知识图谱中，Anthropic 连接 Claude 各版本与 Model Context Protocol。它既是模型研发方，也是影响 Agent 工具连接方式的重要协议推动者，因此需要同时从模型、协议和安全治理三个层面理解。
introduction.en: In the graph, Anthropic connects Claude releases and the Model Context Protocol. It should be understood across models, protocols and safety governance.

significance.zh: Anthropic 的差异不只是“另一个大模型公司”，而是把安全、可解释性和可控性作为产品研发的核心约束。Claude 与 MCP 也使它对长文本、代码 Agent 和工具生态产生了直接影响。
significance.en: Anthropic differentiates itself by treating safety, interpretability and steerability as product constraints. Claude and MCP also shape long-context, coding-agent and tool ecosystems.

description.zh: 人工智能安全与研究公司。
description.en: An AI safety and research company.

description.zh: 构建可靠、可解释和可控的前沿 AI 系统。
description.en: Build reliable, interpretable and steerable frontier AI systems.

description.zh: 通过 Claude 及相关工具把研究转化为面向个人与组织的实际产品。
description.en: Translate research into practical products such as Claude for individuals and organizations.

description.zh: 理解不同 Claude 版本在长上下文、代码、Agent 和安全策略上的变化。
description.en: Follow changes in context, coding, agents and safety behavior across Claude releases.

title.zh: 研究 AI 安全路线

description.zh: 连接模型能力与对齐、可解释性、治理政策等研究方向。
description.en: Connect model capabilities with alignment, interpretability and governance research.

description.zh: 追踪 Anthropic 如何通过开放协议连接模型、数据源和工具。
description.en: Track how Anthropic uses an open protocol to connect models, data and tools.

limitations.zh: 安全与能力指标应区分官方系统卡、独立评测和真实生产表现。
limitations.en: Separate official system cards, independent evaluations and real production behavior.

limitations.zh: 公司理念不能直接替代对具体模型版本和部署风险的评估。
limitations.en: Company principles do not replace evaluation of concrete releases and deployment risks.

summary.zh: Devin AI 软件工程产品的开发组织。
summary.en: Developer of the Devin AI software engineering product.

summary.zh: CrewAI 多 Agent 编排框架的开发组织。
summary.en: Developer of the CrewAI multi-agent orchestration framework.

summary.zh: Gemini 模型和 Gemini CLI 的开发组织。
summary.en: Developer of Gemini models and Gemini CLI.

summary.zh: 提供自主通用 AI Agent 产品与 API 的组织。
summary.en: Organization providing an autonomous general AI agent product and API.

summary.zh: AutoGen 开源项目的维护组织。
summary.en: Maintainer of the AutoGen open-source project.

summary.zh: AI 研究与部署公司，开发 GPT 模型、ChatGPT 与开发者平台，并以“让通用人工智能造福全人类”为使命。
summary.en: AI research and deployment company behind GPT, ChatGPT and its developer platform, with a mission to ensure AGI benefits all humanity.

introduction.zh: OpenAI 是一家同时从事人工智能研究、模型训练和产品部署的机构。对普通用户而言，它最具代表性的产品是 ChatGPT；对开发者和企业而言，GPT 模型与 API 构成了文本生成、代码、多模态理解和 Agent 应用的基础能力。
introduction.en: OpenAI combines AI research, model training and product deployment. ChatGPT is its best-known consumer product, while GPT models and APIs provide foundational capabilities for text, code, multimodality and agents.

introduction.zh: 在 AI Radar 中，OpenAI 不是一个孤立的公司名称，而是 GPT 系列、具体模型版本、评测成绩、价格变化和下游应用的研发方节点。查看该节点的意义，是理解某次模型更新由谁发布、影响哪些产品，以及相关事实来自哪里。
introduction.en: In AI Radar, OpenAI connects the GPT family, concrete releases, benchmark results, pricing changes and downstream applications. The node explains who released an update, what it affects and which evidence supports it.

significance.zh: OpenAI 把前沿模型能力同时带入大众产品和开发者平台，推动了生成式 AI 从研究成果转变为可直接使用的通用工具。追踪 OpenAI，通常意味着同时追踪模型能力、API 生态、产品形态和治理结构的变化。
significance.en: OpenAI helped move frontier models from research into mass-market products and developer infrastructure. Tracking it means following capabilities, APIs, products and governance together.

description.zh: 官方将 OpenAI 定义为人工智能研究与部署公司。
description.en: OpenAI describes itself as an AI research and deployment company.

description.zh: 确保通用人工智能造福全人类。
description.en: Ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all humanity.

description.zh: 由非营利基金会治理营利集团，营利集团以公益公司形式运营。
description.en: A nonprofit foundation governs a for-profit group operating as a public benefit corporation.

description.zh: 查看各版本的发布日期、能力、上下文窗口、价格与继任关系。
description.en: Inspect dates, capabilities, context, pricing and lineage across GPT releases.

description.zh: 分析模型更新会影响哪些 API、开发工具和下游应用。
description.en: See which APIs, developer tools and applications are affected by model updates.

description.zh: 区分官方发布、第三方评测、推断和未经核验的社区信息。
description.en: Separate official releases, independent evaluations, inference and unverified discussion.

limitations.zh: 公司官方材料最适合确认使命、产品和发布信息，但不等同于独立效果评测。
limitations.en: Company materials are authoritative for mission and releases, but are not independent performance evaluations.

limitations.zh: 模型能力、价格和可用范围变化很快，具体结论应以带日期的版本条目为准。
limitations.en: Capabilities, prices and availability change quickly; rely on dated release entries for specific conclusions.

summary.zh: Microsoft 维护的开源 Agent 框架，提供核心运行时、模型客户端扩展和可选代码执行能力。
summary.en: Microsoft-maintained open-source agent framework with a core runtime, model-client extensions and optional code execution.

introduction.zh: AutoGen 是用于构建 Agent 应用的开源框架。
introduction.en: AutoGen is an open-source framework for building agent applications.

introduction.zh: 其安装文档覆盖核心运行时、模型扩展和可选 Docker 代码执行器，实际安全边界由部署者配置。
introduction.en: Its installation documentation covers the core runtime, model extensions and optional Docker executors; deployers configure the real security boundary.

significance.zh: AutoGen 为 Agent 运行时、模型连接和执行器提供了可组合的工程入口。
significance.en: AutoGen provides composable engineering entry points for agent runtime, model connectivity and executors.

description.zh: 官方安装文档提供 autogen-core 作为核心包。
description.en: Official installation documentation provides autogen-core as the core package.

description.zh: OpenAI 与 Azure OpenAI 等模型连接通过扩展安装。
description.en: Model connections such as OpenAI and Azure OpenAI are installed through extensions.

description.zh: 文档建议代码执行可使用 Docker 执行器。
description.en: The documentation recommends Docker executors for code execution.

description.zh: 快速验证模型、工具和消息协作机制。
description.en: Quickly validate models, tools and message collaboration.

description.zh: 在隔离环境中运行模型生成的代码。
description.en: Run model-generated code in isolated environments.

description.zh: 通过客户端扩展连接不同模型提供方。
description.en: Connect multiple model providers through client extensions.

limitations.zh: 执行器与模型密钥配置不当会扩大安全风险。
limitations.en: Misconfigured executors and model credentials can expand security risk.

limitations.zh: 需要自行建设评估、审计和生产可观测性。
limitations.en: Evaluation, audit and production observability remain deployment responsibilities.

summary.zh: 用于构建协作式 Agent、Crew 与 Flow 的 Agent 编排框架。
summary.en: Agent orchestration framework for collaborative agents, crews and flows.

introduction.zh: CrewAI 将协作式 Agent、Crew 和 Flow 作为主要构建块。
introduction.en: CrewAI uses collaborative agents, crews and flows as primary building blocks.

introduction.zh: 它适合表达顺序、分层或混合流程，但生产可靠性仍取决于模型、工具权限和评估。
introduction.en: It supports sequential, hierarchical and hybrid flows, while production reliability still depends on models, tool permissions and evaluation.

significance.zh: CrewAI 用角色、任务和流程组织多 Agent 协作。
significance.en: CrewAI organizes multi-agent collaboration through roles, tasks and flows.

description.zh: 官方文档将 Agents、Crews 和 Flows 作为核心概念。
description.en: Official documentation presents agents, crews and flows as core concepts.

description.zh: Flow 支持状态、路由、持久执行与恢复。
description.en: Flows support state, routing, persistence and resumption.

description.zh: 文档强调 guardrails、memory、knowledge 和 observability。
description.en: The documentation emphasizes guardrails, memory, knowledge and observability.

description.zh: 让不同角色处理检索、整理和复核步骤。
description.en: Assign retrieval, synthesis and review to different roles.

description.zh: 组合触发器、任务和人工介入。
description.en: Combine triggers, tasks and human intervention.

description.zh: 使用结构化结果约束 Agent 产物。
description.en: Constrain agent deliverables with structured results.

limitations.zh: 角色数量不等于可靠性，复杂流程仍需评估。
limitations.en: More roles do not equal reliability; complex flows still need evaluation.

limitations.zh: 工具和外部系统连接必须实施最小权限。
limitations.en: Tool and external-system connections require least privilege.

summary.zh: 用于构建 LLM 应用和 Agent 的开源框架，提供模型与工具集成、预构建 Agent 架构、检索增强和中间件能力。
summary.en: Open-source framework for LLM applications and agents, with model/tool integrations, prebuilt agent architecture, retrieval and middleware.

introduction.zh: LangChain 是一个面向大语言模型应用的开源开发框架。它解决的核心问题不是训练模型，而是把模型与提示、工具、数据源、检索系统和业务流程连接起来，让开发者能较快搭建问答、RAG 和 Agent 应用。
introduction.en: LangChain is an open-source framework for applications powered by language models. It does not train models; it connects models with prompts, tools, data, retrieval and business workflows.

introduction.zh: 当前 LangChain 的高层 Agent API 构建在 LangGraph 运行时之上：LangChain 适合快速开始，LangGraph 更适合需要持久执行、人工介入、精细状态控制和复杂工作流的场景。
introduction.en: Its high-level agents run on LangGraph: LangChain favors fast starts, while LangGraph serves durable execution, human-in-the-loop control and complex workflows.

significance.zh: LangChain 把快速变化的模型与工具接口抽象成相对统一的应用层，使团队更容易替换模型、增加检索或接入工具。它的价值主要在应用编排和生态集成，而不在模型本身。
significance.en: LangChain provides a common application layer over rapidly changing model and tool APIs. Its value is orchestration and integration rather than model capability.

description.zh: 快速构建 Agent、RAG、工具调用与多模型应用。
description.en: Quickly building agents, RAG, tool use and multi-model applications.

description.zh: Agent 在模型与工具之间循环执行，直到产生最终结果或达到停止条件。
description.en: Agents loop between models and tools until a final result or stop condition.

description.zh: LangChain Agent 建立在 LangGraph 之上，高级需求可下沉到更低层运行时。
description.en: LangChain agents use LangGraph underneath, with advanced workflows able to use the lower-level runtime.

description.zh: 连接文档加载器、向量库和检索器，构建有来源的 RAG 问答。
description.en: Combine loaders, vector stores and retrievers for grounded RAG.

description.zh: 让模型根据任务调用搜索、数据库、代码执行或业务 API。
description.en: Let models invoke search, databases, code execution or business APIs.

description.zh: 用统一接口接入不同模型，并在应用层保留编排逻辑。
description.en: Connect multiple providers behind shared application orchestration.

limitations.zh: 抽象层能提高开发速度，但复杂生产系统仍需自行处理评估、监控、权限、成本和失败恢复。
limitations.en: Abstractions speed development, but production systems still need evaluation, observability, permissions, cost control and recovery.

limitations.zh: 简单的一次模型调用通常不需要引入完整框架。
limitations.en: A simple one-shot model call often does not require a full framework.

summary.zh: 用于构建、管理和部署长运行、有状态 Agent 的低层编排框架与运行时。
summary.en: Low-level orchestration framework and runtime for long-running, stateful agents.

introduction.zh: LangGraph 是面向复杂、有状态 Agent 的低层编排框架。
introduction.en: LangGraph is a low-level orchestration framework for complex, stateful agents.

introduction.zh: 它可以独立使用，也常与 LangChain 组件配合；应根据是否需要持久执行和精细状态控制选择。
introduction.en: It can be used standalone or with LangChain components; choose it when durable execution and fine-grained state control matter.

significance.zh: LangGraph 将 Agent 工作流中的状态、恢复和人工介入显式化。
significance.en: LangGraph makes agent workflow state, recovery and human intervention explicit.

description.zh: 官方概览将其定位为 Agent 编排运行时。
description.en: The official overview positions it as an agent orchestration runtime.

description.zh: 重点能力包括持久执行、流式处理、人工介入和记忆。
description.en: Highlighted capabilities include durable execution, streaming, human oversight and memory.

description.zh: 使用 LangGraph 不要求同时采用 LangChain。
description.en: Using LangGraph does not require adopting LangChain.

description.zh: 处理可恢复、可暂停的多步骤工作流。
description.en: Handle resumable, pausable multi-step workflows.

description.zh: 在关键状态节点加入人工审核。
description.en: Add human approval at critical state transitions.

description.zh: 查看 Agent 状态与流程路径，辅助调试。
description.en: Inspect agent state and paths to support debugging.

limitations.zh: 低层抽象需要团队自行设计状态和错误处理。
limitations.en: Low-level abstractions require teams to design their own state and error handling.

limitations.zh: 框架本身不保证底层模型事实正确。
limitations.en: The framework itself does not guarantee factual correctness from the underlying model.

summary.zh: 连接 AI 应用与外部数据、工具和工作流的开放协议，通过 Host—Client—Server 架构统一上下文交换与能力调用。
summary.en: Open protocol connecting AI applications with external data, tools and workflows through a host-client-server architecture.

introduction.zh: Model Context Protocol（MCP）是一套开放协议，用来标准化 AI 应用与外部系统之间的连接。过去每个模型应用都要为数据库、文件系统、开发工具或 SaaS 服务分别编写集成；MCP 把这些连接抽象成共同的协议和 SDK。
introduction.en: Model Context Protocol is an open standard for connecting AI applications with external systems. Instead of bespoke integrations for databases, files, developer tools or SaaS products, MCP provides a shared protocol and SDKs.

introduction.zh: MCP 采用 Host—Client—Server 架构：Host 是 Claude Desktop、IDE 或其他 AI 应用；Host 为每个 Server 创建 Client；Server 暴露 tools、resources 和 prompts。它规定的是通信与能力发现方式，不规定底层模型，也不会自动替代权限和安全控制。
introduction.en: MCP uses a host-client-server architecture. A host creates a client for each server, while servers expose tools, resources and prompts. It standardizes communication and discovery, not the underlying model or security policy.

significance.zh: MCP 的价值类似 AI 工具生态中的通用连接层：工具提供方实现一次 Server，多个兼容 Host 即可接入；AI 应用也不必为每个服务维护完全不同的适配代码。
significance.en: MCP acts as a common connectivity layer: a provider can implement one server for multiple compatible hosts, while AI apps avoid maintaining wholly separate integrations.

description.zh: 用户实际操作的 AI 应用，负责权限、生命周期和用户体验。
description.en: The AI application users operate, responsible for permissions, lifecycle and UX.

description.zh: Host 内与单个 MCP Server 保持会话和通信的协议组件。
description.en: The protocol component maintaining a session with one MCP server.

description.zh: 向 AI 应用提供工具、资源或提示模板的程序。
description.en: A program exposing tools, resources or prompt templates to an AI application.

description.zh: 让 AI 应用按权限读取知识库、文件、数据库或业务系统。
description.en: Provide permissioned access to knowledge bases, files, databases and business systems.

description.zh: 把搜索、代码执行、工单、监控或设计工具暴露给 Agent。
description.en: Expose search, code execution, tickets, monitoring or design tools to agents.

description.zh: 同一个 MCP Server 可被多个兼容客户端复用。
description.en: Reuse one MCP server across multiple compatible clients.

limitations.zh: 协议兼容不等于安全；Host 仍需限制工具权限、敏感数据、网络范围和用户确认流程。
limitations.en: Protocol compatibility is not security; hosts must still govern tools, data, network access and confirmation.

limitations.zh: 不同客户端与 Server 对规范版本、传输方式和扩展能力的支持可能不一致。
limitations.en: Clients and servers may differ in specification versions, transports and extensions.

summary.zh: 用于构建 Agent 应用的轻量 Python SDK，提供 Agent、工具、Handoff、Guardrail、会话和追踪能力。
summary.en: Lightweight Python SDK for agentic applications with agents, tools, handoffs, guardrails, sessions and tracing.

introduction.zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 是构建 Agent 应用的 Python SDK。
introduction.en: The OpenAI Agents SDK is a Python SDK for agentic applications.

introduction.zh: 它在模型调用之上提供 Agent 循环、工具、handoff、guardrail、会话和追踪等编排能力。
introduction.en: It provides an agent loop, tools, handoffs, guardrails, sessions and tracing above model calls.

significance.zh: 该 SDK 为 OpenAI 模型上的 Agent 运行时提供了较小且可组合的抽象集合。
significance.en: The SDK supplies a small, composable set of runtime abstractions for agents on OpenAI models.

description.zh: 文档列出 Agent、工具、handoff 和 guardrail 等核心原语。
description.en: Documentation lists agents, tools, handoffs and guardrails as core primitives.

description.zh: 内置 Agent loop 可管理工具调用并继续执行直到完成。
description.en: The built-in agent loop can manage tool calls and continue until completion.

description.zh: SDK 提供 tracing，用于可视化和调试 Agent 流程。
description.en: The SDK provides tracing for visualizing and debugging agent flows.

description.zh: 为模型接入经过模式校验的函数工具。
description.en: Connect schema-validated function tools to models.

description.zh: 根据任务选择 manager 或 handoff 模式。
description.en: Choose manager or handoff patterns per task.

description.zh: 记录追踪并用评估检查输出。
description.en: Capture traces and evaluate outputs.

limitations.zh: SDK 不能替代工具权限、数据治理和业务评估。
limitations.en: The SDK does not replace tool permissions, data governance or product evaluation.

limitations.zh: Agent 设计需要控制成本、失败恢复和人工介入。
limitations.en: Agent design still needs cost control, failure recovery and human oversight.

summary.zh: Anthropic 推出的以安全对齐与长文本理解见长的大型语言模型家族，Claude 4.5 强化了代码与 Agent 场景。
summary.en: Anthropic's LLM family known for safety alignment and long-context understanding; Claude 4.5 focuses on code and agentic use cases.

introduction.zh: Claude 是 Anthropic 的通用模型家族，产品定位强调可靠性、安全对齐、长文档处理与复杂工具工作流。系列中的 Haiku、Sonnet、Opus 或不同代际通常面向不同的速度、成本与能力层级。
introduction.en: Claude is Anthropic's general-purpose model family, positioned around reliability, safety alignment, long documents and complex tool workflows. Haiku, Sonnet, Opus and different generations target different speed, cost and capability tiers.

introduction.zh: 选择 Claude 时应使用完整版本名与日期化模型 ID。只说“Claude”无法说明上下文窗口、是否支持扩展思考、Computer Use、MCP 或当前价格。
introduction.en: A Claude decision should use a full release name and dated model ID. “Claude” alone does not specify context, extended thinking, Computer Use, MCP support or current pricing.

significance.zh: Claude 把长文本、代码 Agent 与安全工程结合成清晰的产品路线，是评估企业文档、软件工程和高可靠工作流时的重要候选。
significance.en: Claude combines long context, coding agents and safety engineering into a distinct product line, making it a key candidate for enterprise documents, software engineering and reliability-sensitive workflows.

description.zh: 除长文档外，Claude 系列也持续强化代码、工具使用、扩展思考与 Agent 稳定性。
description.en: Beyond documents, Claude continues to develop code, tool use, extended thinking and agent reliability.

description.zh: 高能力、均衡和高速度型号不可混为一谈，应按任务难度和吞吐要求选择。
description.en: High-capability, balanced and fast tiers are not interchangeable; choose by task difficulty and throughput.

description.zh: Computer Use 与 Agent 能力越强，越需要沙箱、最小权限、审计与人工确认。
description.en: Stronger computer-use and agent capabilities require sandboxing, least privilege, audit and confirmation.

description.zh: 适合合同、研究资料、政策和多文档综合，仍需核对引用是否真的支持结论。
description.en: Useful for contracts, research, policy and multi-document synthesis, with citation verification.

description.zh: 适合仓库级代码理解、重构和多步骤修复，需在受控环境运行。
description.en: Useful for repository-level understanding, refactoring and multi-step fixes in controlled environments.

description.zh: 适合结构化报告、分析与流程协作，可结合 MCP 接入经过授权的数据源。
description.en: Useful for structured reports, analysis and workflows, with MCP-connected authorized data.

limitations.zh: 超长上下文不保证模型能同等准确地利用每一处信息，关键事实仍需定位和复核。
limitations.en: A long context window does not guarantee equal attention to every detail; critical facts still need verification.

limitations.zh: 安全策略可能导致拒答或保守输出，需用真实业务样本评估可用性。
limitations.en: Safety policies may cause refusals or conservative output; evaluate with real business samples.

limitations.zh: 本演示中的 Claude 4.5 未来规格需以 Anthropic 正式资料为准。
limitations.en: Future Claude 4.5 specifications in this demo must be checked against official Anthropic material.

summary.zh: Claude 系列的重要效率版本，强化代码、视觉理解与 Artifacts 交互，在性能和价格之间取得平衡。
summary.en: A major efficiency release adding stronger code, vision, and Artifacts while balancing capability and price.

summary.zh: 面向长时间 Agent 任务与复杂代码工程的版本，增加扩展思考和更稳定的多步骤工具调用。
summary.en: A release for long-running agent tasks and complex software engineering, adding extended thinking and steadier multi-step tool use.

specs.toolUse: 并行工具调用 · Computer use

summary.zh: Claude 系列当前演示旗舰版本，进一步提升代码、长文档和 Agent 稳定性，并降低安全策略的误拒率。
summary.en: The current demo flagship Claude release with stronger code, long-document work, and agent reliability, plus fewer false safety refusals.

specs.toolUse: 并行工具调用 · MCP · Computer use

summary.zh: 国产开源前沿模型代表，DeepSeek R2 主打推理与代码，训练与推理成本大幅低于同代闭源模型。
summary.en: Leading Chinese open-source frontier models; DeepSeek R2 focuses on reasoning and code with markedly lower training & inference cost.

introduction.zh: DeepSeek 是深度求索推出的模型家族，包含通用基座、推理与代码方向。它因开放权重、MoE 架构、中文与代码能力以及较低的部署与调用成本受到关注。
introduction.en: DeepSeek is a model family from DeepSeek spanning general, reasoning and coding releases. It is known for open weights, MoE architecture, Chinese and code capability, and cost-efficient deployment and inference.

introduction.zh: “开放权重”并不等于可以无条件使用：许可证、硬件需求、量化损失、推理框架和运维成本都会影响实际落地。API 版本与自托管权重也可能不是同一快照。
introduction.en: Open weights do not mean frictionless use: license, hardware, quantization, inference stack and operations all affect deployment. API releases and self-hosted weights may also be different snapshots.

significance.zh: DeepSeek 让前沿推理能力、开放部署和成本效率进入同一讨论框架，对私有化、国产化和高调用量场景具有代表性。
significance.en: DeepSeek puts frontier reasoning, open deployment and cost efficiency into one decision space, making it important for private deployment and high-volume workloads.

description.zh: 既可使用 API，也可在许可证和资源允许时部署开放权重。
description.en: Use the API or deploy open weights when licensing and infrastructure allow.

description.zh: V 系列与 R 系列面向的任务、延迟和推理行为不同，不能只比较系列名。
description.en: V and R releases differ in tasks, latency and reasoning behavior; compare concrete models.

title.zh: 低单价不等于低总成本
title.en: Low price is not low TCO

description.zh: 自托管还需计算 GPU、并发、监控、安全和模型更新成本。
description.en: Self-hosting also includes GPU, concurrency, monitoring, security and upgrade costs.

description.zh: 适合可验证的数学、算法和代码任务，最好配合测试与执行环境。
description.en: Useful for verifiable math, algorithms and code with tests and execution.

description.zh: 适合有数据边界或定制推理需求的组织，但需要成熟的模型运维能力。
description.en: Useful for data-boundary or custom-inference needs, with mature model operations.

description.zh: 可作为成本敏感型候选，需用真实吞吐和质量目标测算总成本。
description.en: A cost-sensitive candidate when evaluated using real throughput and quality targets.

limitations.zh: 本演示中的 DeepSeek-R2 属于预览/演示数据，不应被视为已正式发布事实。

limitations.zh: 不同托管平台的上下文、并发、内容策略和价格可能不同。
limitations.en: Context, concurrency, content policy and price vary by hosting provider.

limitations.zh: 开放部署需要自行承担安全更新、滥用防护与输出质量监控。
limitations.en: Open deployment requires owning security updates, abuse controls and quality monitoring.

summary.en: A demo release for math, code and long-chain reasoning, continuing DeepSeek's open-weight and low-cost deployment strategy.

summary.zh: 字节跳动的豆包模型家族，服务于抖音、剪映等 C 端产品，主打低成本与高并发。
summary.en: ByteDance's Doubao family powering consumer products like Douyin & CapCut, focused on cost and throughput.

capabilities.zh: 多模态文档与视频理解

introduction.zh: 豆包背后的通用模型由字节跳动 Seed 团队研发，并通过豆包 App、火山方舟和字节系产品提供服务。它不只是一个聊天应用，而是一组覆盖通用、多模态、代码、语音、图像和视频生成的模型产品。
introduction.en: The models behind Doubao are developed by ByteDance Seed and delivered through the Doubao app, Volcano Engine and ByteDance products. It is a portfolio spanning general, multimodal, code, speech, image and video models.

introduction.zh: 2026 年发布的 Seed 2.0 系列面向大规模生产与复杂真实任务，包含 Pro、Lite、Mini 三个通用 Agent 档位和专用 Code 模型，强化了文档、图表、视频、长上下文与多步骤指令。
introduction.en: The 2026 Seed 2.0 line targets large-scale production and complex real-world tasks, with Pro, Lite and Mini agent tiers plus a Code model, improving documents, charts, video, long context and multi-step instructions.

significance.zh: 豆包体现了模型从 C 端大规模交互走向企业 MaaS、Agent 和生成媒体平台的路线，其优势需从吞吐、成本、模态和生态接入综合判断。
significance.en: Doubao shows a path from mass consumer interaction to enterprise MaaS, agents and generative media; its value spans throughput, cost, modalities and ecosystem integration.

description.zh: 官方资料显示其面向复杂真实任务，并提供 Pro、Lite、Mini 与 Code 四种定位。
description.en: Official material positions it for complex real-world tasks with Pro, Lite, Mini and Code variants.

description.zh: 重点能力包括复杂文档、图表、长视频、空间与运动理解。
description.en: Core capabilities include complex documents, charts, long video, spatial and motion understanding.

description.zh: Pro、Lite 和 Mini 用于平衡能力、速度与成本，Code 则面向软件工程。
description.en: Pro, Lite and Mini balance capability, speed and cost while Code targets software engineering.

description.zh: 用于文档、图表和视频理解，适合火山方舟上的生产工作流。
description.en: For document, chart and video understanding in Volcano Engine production workflows.

description.zh: 通过不同档位平衡质量、延迟和成本，需用真实流量压测。
description.en: Balance quality, latency and cost across tiers using realistic load tests.

description.zh: Code 与通用 Agent 型号适合多步骤开发和工具任务，需限制执行权限。
description.en: Code and agent variants support multi-step development and tools with restricted permissions.

limitations.zh: 豆包 App、Seed 模型和火山方舟 API 是不同层次的产品，功能不能直接互相代替。
limitations.en: The Doubao app, Seed models and Volcano Engine APIs are different product layers and are not interchangeable.

limitations.zh: 官方 Benchmark 结果需要结合第三方评测和自身任务复核。
limitations.en: Official benchmarks should be checked against third-party and task-specific evaluations.

limitations.zh: 地域、合规、配额和实时价格取决于具体云服务与合同。
limitations.en: Region, compliance, quota and live pricing depend on the cloud service and contract.

summary.zh: 面向真实工作流的通用 Agent 模型，支持文本与图像输入、搜索、代码、GUI 交互和三种思考模式。
summary.en: A general agent model for real workflows with text and image input, search, code, GUI interaction and three thinking modes.

summary.en: The flagship general agent in Seed 2.0, improving multimodal understanding, long-chain reasoning and stability in complex workflows.

summary.zh: 百度文心系列模型，当前已迭代到 ERNIE 5.1，强化 Agent、推理、搜索增强、知识与创意写作能力。
summary.en: Baidu's ERNIE family, now at ERNIE 5.1, with stronger agents, reasoning, search, knowledge and creative writing.

introduction.zh: ERNIE（文心）是百度的大模型家族，与百度搜索、知识增强、飞桨和千帆平台结合，面向对话、内容生产、Agent 和行业解决方案。
introduction.en: ERNIE is Baidu's model family, integrated with search, knowledge grounding, PaddlePaddle and the Qianfan platform for chat, content, agents and industry solutions.

introduction.zh: ERNIE 5.1 于 2026 年 5 月正式发布，在继承 ERNIE 5.0 预训练基础的同时压缩模型规模，重点提升 Agent、推理、知识和创意写作，并强调训练与推理成本效率。
introduction.en: ERNIE 5.1 was officially released in May 2026, inheriting ERNIE 5.0 pretraining while compressing model size and improving agents, reasoning, knowledge, creative writing and cost efficiency.

significance.zh: ERNIE 的差异化来自模型、搜索、中文知识和企业平台的结合，适合需要国内云服务、搜索增强或行业集成的团队重点评估。
significance.en: ERNIE is differentiated by the combination of models, search, Chinese knowledge and enterprise platforms, especially for teams needing domestic cloud, grounding or industry integration.

description.zh: 官方发布于 2026 年 5 月，强调更高参数效率与更低训练成本。
description.en: Officially released in May 2026 with improved parameter and training efficiency.

description.zh: 后训练路线面向长程 Agent、工具任务、知识与推理能力整合。
description.en: Post-training targets long-horizon agents, tools, knowledge and reasoning integration.

description.zh: 搜索、千帆、飞桨和行业方案会显著影响其实际落地价值。
description.en: Search, Qianfan, PaddlePaddle and industry solutions materially affect adoption value.

description.zh: 用于需要最新中文信息和网页检索的问答，仍需展示来源并处理冲突。
description.en: For current Chinese information and web-grounded Q&A with citations and conflict handling.

description.zh: 用于工具调用、表格和行业流程，可结合千帆平台治理权限和资源。
description.en: For tools, spreadsheets and industry workflows governed through Qianfan.

description.zh: 适合中文创意写作、知识问答和行业内容，需要业务语料评测。
description.en: Useful for Chinese writing, knowledge QA and industry content with domain evaluation.

limitations.zh: 官方排行榜和内部评测不能替代独立评测与真实业务测试。
limitations.en: Official leaderboards and internal evaluations do not replace independent and task-specific testing.

limitations.zh: 不同千帆模型 ID、区域和服务档位的能力、价格与限制可能不同。
limitations.en: Capability, price and limits vary across Qianfan model IDs, regions and service tiers.

limitations.zh: 搜索增强可能继承网页来源的错误、偏差和时效问题，必须保留证据链。
limitations.en: Search grounding can inherit source errors, bias and staleness; retain an evidence trail.

summary.zh: 包含十款开放权重变体的多模态 MoE 模型系列，覆盖文本、视觉理解、思考模式与本地部署。
summary.en: A ten-variant open-weight multimodal MoE family spanning text, vision, thinking modes and local deployment.

summary.en: An efficient release extracted from ERNIE 5.0's elastic model matrix, strengthening agents, reasoning, knowledge, deep search and writing.

summary.zh: Google DeepMind 的多模态旗舰模型家族，原生支持文本、图像、音频与视频输入。
summary.en: Google DeepMind's multimodal flagship family with native text, image, audio and video inputs.

introduction.zh: Gemini 是 Google DeepMind 的多模态模型家族，围绕文本、图像、音频、视频、代码和搜索增强构建。它既出现在 Gemini 消费产品中，也通过 Gemini API 与 Vertex AI 面向开发者和企业。
introduction.en: Gemini is Google DeepMind's multimodal model family spanning text, image, audio, video, code and search grounding. It appears in the Gemini consumer product and through Gemini API and Vertex AI.

introduction.zh: 系列名称下包含 Pro、Flash 等不同定位以及多个代际。评估时要区分具体版本、上下文窗口、思考能力、区域可用性和云平台计费。
introduction.en: The family contains Pro, Flash and other tiers across generations. Evaluation must distinguish the exact release, context, thinking behavior, regional availability and cloud pricing.

significance.zh: Gemini 的核心价值是把原生多模态、长上下文、搜索与 Google 云生态结合，适合需要处理复杂媒体或大量上下文的产品。
significance.en: Gemini's core value is the combination of native multimodality, long context, search and Google Cloud, especially for media-rich or context-heavy products.

description.zh: 重点不只是识图，而是统一处理文本、图像、音频、视频和代码。
description.en: The focus goes beyond image understanding to unified text, image, audio, video and code.

description.zh: 可用于长视频、代码库和多文档分析，但长上下文仍不等于可靠召回。
description.en: Useful for long video, codebases and document sets, though long context does not guarantee reliable recall.

description.zh: Gemini 应用、API 与 Vertex AI 的功能、配额和数据治理选项并不完全相同。
description.en: Gemini app, API and Vertex AI differ in features, quotas and data-governance options.

description.zh: 用于视频摘要、片段定位与跨模态问答，并需抽样核对时间点和事实。
description.en: For video summary, moment retrieval and cross-modal Q&A, with sampled fact checking.

description.zh: 用于长文档、代码仓库和会议资料综合，适合先检索再精读的流程。
description.en: For documents, repositories and meeting corpora, ideally with retrieve-then-read workflows.

description.zh: 适合已经使用 Vertex AI、搜索和 Google 数据平台的企业系统。
description.en: Useful for enterprise systems already using Vertex AI, search and Google data services.

limitations.zh: 不同区域、产品入口和模型档位的可用性与限制可能不同。
limitations.en: Availability and limits vary by region, product surface and model tier.

limitations.zh: 多模态回答仍可能误读图表、视频时序或细小视觉信息。
limitations.en: Multimodal answers can still misread charts, temporal video details or small visual elements.

limitations.zh: 本页未来版本与演示价格不代表 Google 当前正式报价。
limitations.en: Future releases and demo prices on this page do not represent Google's live official pricing.

summary.zh: Gemini 系列率先把超长上下文带入稳定产品形态的版本，适合长文档、代码库和长视频分析。
summary.en: The Gemini release that brought ultra-long context into a stable product for documents, codebases and long video.

specs.modalities: 文本 · 图像 · 音频 · 视频
specs.toolUse: 函数调用 · 代码执行

capabilities.zh: 超长文档与代码库分析

summary.zh: 在长上下文基础上增加思考模式、代码和复杂多模态推理，是 Gemini 系列当前演示旗舰版本。
summary.en: Adds thinking, coding and complex multimodal reasoning on top of long context; the current demo Gemini flagship.

specs.modalities: 文本 · 图像 · 音频 · 视频
specs.toolUse: 函数调用 · 代码执行 · 搜索增强

summary.zh: OpenAI 推出的通用大型语言模型家族，覆盖对话、代码、推理与多模态能力，是当前商业化最成熟的闭源前沿模型之一。
summary.en: OpenAI's general-purpose LLM family covering chat, code, reasoning and multimodal capabilities; among the most commercially mature closed frontier models today.

introduction.zh: GPT 是 OpenAI 的通用生成式模型家族。“GPT 系列”是一个持续迭代的产品谱系，不等于某个固定模型：GPT-4o、GPT-4.5 与本演示中的 GPT-5 在速度、推理、模态、工具调用和价格上各有不同。
introduction.en: GPT is OpenAI's general-purpose generative model family. It is an evolving lineage rather than one fixed model: GPT-4o, GPT-4.5 and the demo GPT-5 differ in speed, reasoning, modalities, tools and price.

introduction.zh: 理解 GPT 的关键不是记住“第几代”，而是先确定具体版本与入口，再核对上下文、工具能力、数据政策和实时计费。ChatGPT 产品中的模型体验也不能直接等同于 API 型号。
introduction.en: The key is not memorizing the generation number but identifying the concrete release and access channel, then checking context, tools, data policy and current pricing. A ChatGPT experience is not automatically identical to an API model.

significance.zh: GPT 影响了对话式 AI、代码助手和 Agent 产品的通用交互范式，也是闭源模型能力与商业化成熟度的重要参照系。
significance.en: GPT shaped the interaction pattern for conversational AI, coding assistants and agents, and remains a major reference point for closed-model capability and commercialization.

title.zh: 它是系列，不是单一型号

description.zh: 比较时应选 GPT-4o、GPT-4.5、GPT-5 等具体版本，不能只写“GPT”。
description.en: Comparisons should select GPT-4o, GPT-4.5, GPT-5 or another concrete release, not just “GPT.”

description.zh: 系列覆盖文本、图像、语音、代码、推理和工具调用，但各版本组合不同。
description.en: The family spans text, image, audio, code, reasoning and tools, with different combinations by release.

description.zh: 同系列版本之间的输入、输出价格和延迟差异足以改变产品方案。
description.en: Input/output pricing and latency can differ enough across releases to change the product decision.

description.zh: 用于问答、写作、信息整理与多轮交互，需要结合检索和验证控制事实风险。
description.en: For Q&A, writing, synthesis and multi-turn interaction, with retrieval and verification for factual risk.

description.zh: 用于代码生成、工具调用和工作流编排，适合具备权限边界与失败恢复的系统。
description.en: For code generation, tool use and workflow orchestration in systems with permission boundaries and recovery.

description.zh: 用于图像、语音和文本组合交互，但需按具体 API 核对支持的输入输出模态。
description.en: For combined image, audio and text experiences, after checking the exact API modalities.

limitations.zh: 闭源服务的模型权重、训练数据和部分评测细节不可见，能力判断需要外部验证。
limitations.en: Weights, training data and some evaluation details are not public, so capability claims need independent validation.

limitations.zh: 模型会生成错误事实；高风险场景必须增加检索、引用、规则和人工复核。
limitations.en: Models can produce false statements; high-risk use requires retrieval, citations, rules and human review.

limitations.zh: 本页 GPT-5 的未来版本数据属于演示内容，不能作为真实采购或价格依据。
limitations.en: Future-dated GPT-5 data on this page is demo content and must not be used for procurement or pricing.

summary.zh: 面向自然对话、知识广度与创意写作的过渡版本，推理方式更自然，但 API 成本明显高于 GPT-4o。
summary.en: A transitional release focused on natural conversation, broad knowledge, and writing quality, at a substantially higher API price than GPT-4o.

summary.zh: GPT 系列的原生多模态版本，将文本、图像与语音整合进单一模型，重点改善实时交互速度与成本。
summary.en: A native multimodal GPT release unifying text, image, and audio, with an emphasis on latency and cost.

specs.modalities: 文本 · 图像 · 音频
specs.toolUse: 函数调用 · 结构化输出

summary.zh: GPT 系列当前演示旗舰版本，统一快速响应与深度推理，强化代码、长上下文、多模态与 Agent 工具调用。
summary.en: The current demo flagship GPT release, unifying fast responses and deep reasoning with stronger code, long context, multimodality, and agentic tool use.

specs.modalities: 文本 · 图像 · 音频 · 视频
specs.toolUse: 并行工具调用 · Agent 编排

summary.zh: 月之暗面 Kimi 以超长上下文与深度阅读见长，主打个人研究与文档理解。
summary.en: Moonshot's Kimi is known for ultra-long context and deep-reading workflows for personal research.

capabilities.zh: 代码与 Agent 工作流

introduction.zh: Kimi 是月之暗面推出的模型与 AI 助手产品家族，早期以长文本阅读建立认知，随后扩展到开放模型、代码 Agent、视觉理解、深度推理和工具调用。
introduction.en: Kimi is Moonshot AI's model and assistant family. It first became known for long-document reading and later expanded into open models, coding agents, vision, deep reasoning and tool use.

introduction.zh: 截至本页核验时间，Kimi 官方 API 平台把 K3 列为旗舰模型，提供 1M 上下文，面向软件工程、知识工作与深度推理；K2.7 Code 与 K2.6 分别覆盖代码和通用多模态任务。
introduction.en: At this page's verification date, Kimi's official API platform lists K3 as its flagship with a 1M context window for software engineering, knowledge work and deep reasoning, alongside K2.7 Code and K2.6.

significance.zh: Kimi 已从“长文档聊天工具”演进为面向知识工作和软件工程的模型平台，适合观察超长上下文如何与 Agent、代码和工具生态结合。
significance.en: Kimi has evolved from a long-document chat tool into a model platform for knowledge work and software engineering, combining long context with agents, code and tools.

description.zh: 官方平台列出的 K3 支持 1M 上下文，聚焦软件工程、知识工作和深度推理。
description.en: The official platform lists K3 with a 1M context window for software engineering, knowledge work and deep reasoning.

description.zh: K3、K2.7 Code 与 K2.6 的定位不同，不能用“Kimi”一个名称替代具体模型。
description.en: K3, K2.7 Code and K2.6 target different jobs; “Kimi” is not a sufficient model identifier.

description.zh: 官方平台提供搜索、代码执行、表格、抓取和记忆等工具，适合复杂工作流。
description.en: The platform offers search, code execution, spreadsheet, fetch and memory tools for workflows.

description.zh: 用于多来源资料阅读、分析和报告生成，必须保留来源并复核推断。
description.en: For multi-source reading, analysis and reports with retained citations and checked inferences.

description.zh: 用于仓库理解、调试和多步骤开发，需配合受控执行环境。
description.en: For repository understanding, debugging and multi-step development in controlled execution.

description.zh: 适合将长上下文、表格分析和工具调用组合成知识工作流程。
description.en: Useful for combining long context, spreadsheet analysis and tools into knowledge workflows.

limitations.zh: 1M 上下文是容量上限，不代表在超长输入中对所有细节保持相同准确率。
limitations.en: A 1M context window is a capacity limit, not a guarantee of equal accuracy across every detail.

limitations.zh: 不同模型的价格、上下文与工具支持差异明显，使用前应查看官方模型目录。
limitations.en: Price, context and tools differ materially across releases; check the official catalog before use.

limitations.zh: 深度研究和 Agent 输出仍可能错误引用或执行不当，需要来源核验与权限控制。

summary.zh: 2017 年提出 Transformer 的论文，以自注意力取代循环和卷积作为序列建模核心，成为现代大语言模型的重要架构基础。
summary.en: The 2017 paper introducing the Transformer, replacing recurrence and convolution with attention as the core of sequence modeling.

introduction.zh: 《Attention Is All You Need》由 Ashish Vaswani 等八位作者在 2017 年发表。论文提出 Transformer：不再依赖循环神经网络逐词处理序列，而是用自注意力计算序列中不同位置之间的关联。
introduction.en: Published in 2017 by Ashish Vaswani and seven coauthors, Attention Is All You Need introduced the Transformer, replacing recurrent sequence processing with self-attention across positions.

introduction.zh: 原论文面向机器翻译，采用编码器—解码器结构，并结合多头注意力、前馈网络、残差连接和位置编码。后来的 BERT、GPT 和大量多模态模型并非原样复制，而是选择其编码器、解码器或其他变体并大规模扩展。
introduction.en: The original machine-translation model used an encoder-decoder with multi-head attention, feed-forward networks, residual connections and positional encoding. Later systems such as BERT and GPT adapted and scaled selected parts.

significance.zh: Transformer 允许序列位置并行计算，显著提高训练效率和扩展能力，为后续扩大模型参数、数据量和上下文长度提供了可行架构。
significance.en: Parallel computation across sequence positions improved training efficiency and scalability, enabling later growth in parameters, data and context.

description.zh: 以注意力机制为核心，移除循环和卷积序列层。
description.en: Use attention as the core mechanism without recurrent or convolutional sequence layers.

description.zh: 首先在英德和英法机器翻译任务上验证。
description.en: Initially evaluated on English–German and English–French translation.

description.zh: 相较循环网络更容易并行训练，训练时间显著降低。
description.en: More parallelizable than recurrent networks, with substantially lower training time.

description.zh: 解释 GPT、BERT、Claude 等模型为何在图谱中与 Transformer 相连。
description.en: Explain why families such as GPT, BERT and Claude trace back to Transformers.

description.zh: 理解自注意力、多头注意力、位置编码与编码器—解码器。
description.en: Study self-attention, multi-head attention, positional encoding and encoder-decoder design.

description.zh: 判断后续模型保留、删除或改造了原架构的哪些部分。
description.en: Identify which original components later models retain, remove or modify.

limitations.zh: 原论文结论来自机器翻译实验，不能直接等同于今天所有大语言模型的能力结论。
limitations.en: The original evidence came from translation and does not directly establish modern LLM capabilities.

limitations.zh: 标准注意力的计算与内存成本随序列长度快速增长，长上下文模型通常需要额外优化。
limitations.en: Standard attention becomes expensive with sequence length, so long-context models require further optimization.
